reading.title: Who owns your data?
reading.text: Personal data is one of the most sensitive issues of our time. When we install an app, we usually give our consent with one click, without reading the terms. Public sentiment is changing, however. After several scandals, many users resent the way companies collect information about them, and newspapers run sensational stories about data leaks. Most experts agree that the sensible solution is not to ban data collection but to make the rules shorter and clearer, so that people know what they are agreeing to.

write: Should companies be allowed to collect personal data from their users? Viết 2–3 câu, dùng ít nhất 2 từ trong chương.
